endpoint_policy: Table3 unstarred recommendation only; no caution endpoints in primary fits; PRAD OS excluded
score: continuous HR per one SD of frozen module score in all nonredacted primary patients of same cancer, before endpoint/complete-case filtering; genes and direction unchanged
stage: strict Roman I-IV with optional A/B/C and 1/2 substage; early I/II versus late III/IV; per cancer pathologic stage if >=50% interpretable else clinical stage if >=50% else unavailable; no patient-level fallback; raw fields and source retained; IS/Stage X/discrepancy/unknown/I-II NOS excluded
time: curated OS.time/PFI.time in days from initial diagnosis, finite >0; event exactly 0/1; PFI inclusive TCGA-CDR definition, not treatment-specific PFS
fit: R survival coxph Efron, no penalizer, no intercept, ordinary model covariance, unique patients, iter.max=100; warnings/errors/nonfinite or rank deficient fits are unqualified
PH: cox.zph km transform, global and each term; retain flags even when primary association significant; nonsignificant PH test does not prove proportionality
multiplicity: joint BH of CM Wald p over all successful cancers/endpoints/models/branches/modules; separate BH across all PH term/global diagnostic tests; failures and exclusions retained
constants: omit constant covariates explicitly and record names; reject constant score or rank deficient design; require at least 10 events per retained coefficient
validation: all source/score keys and redaction audit; independent Python PHReg Efron refit and numerical p/BH replay before interpretation
limitations: exploratory previously used cohort, no external prognosis validation; complete-case selection and compositional conditioning may bias associations; no treatment-specific prediction; stage absent in several cancers and binary stage omits clinical detail; PH violations require follow-up, not a stable HR claim
